question: Six persons A, F, W, K, P and C live on the six-floor building. Each person lives on each floor. The lowest floor is numbered as floor 1, its above floor is numbered as floor 2 and so on and the top most floor is numbered as floor 6. F lives on floor 4. W lives between A and K. K does not lives on the lowest floor. K lives below F's floor. P lives on an even-numbered floor. Who lives between C and K?
solution:
